## Automated Tests Required

### S5-M2: HUD Round State Display (UI / Integration)

**Test file path**: `tests/integration/hud/round_state_display_test.ts`

**What to test**:
- ROUND_STARTED event → round number Label updates to ctx.roundNumber
- ALIVE_COUNT_CHANGED event → alive count Label updates to event.aliveCount
- ROUND_END event → timer stops; final time displayed
- GAME_OVER event → "Final Round: N" text updates
- IEventBus.on() subscription is registered once at construction (ADR-0001)
- IEventBus.off() cleanup on HUD destroy/dispose

**Edge cases**:
- Multiple ROUND_STARTED events (round transition) → label re-renders
- ALIVE_COUNT_CHANGED with count=0 → display correctly handles zero
- Subscription order does not affect rendering (event-driven, not pull)

**Estimated test count**: ~10 integration tests

---

### S5-M3: HUD Grid Render + Goal Cell Highlight (UI / Visual/Feel)

**Test file path**: `tests/integration/hud/grid_render_test.ts`

**What to test**:
- CELL_STATE_CHANGED with state='IDLE' → cell node sprite/color = idle
- CELL_STATE_CHANGED with state='EXPLODED' → cell node sprite/color = exploded
- GOAL_PLACED event → goal cell highlight overlay applied
- 8×8 grid: 64 cell nodes registered correctly at construction
- Pattern application: ApplyPattern() upstream → all CELL_STATE_CHANGED events flow to correct cells

**Edge cases**:
- Rapid CELL_STATE_CHANGED toggles (IDLE→EXPLODED→IDLE within 1 tick) → final state rendered
- Goal cell on a gate cell: highlight + state both visible
- Out-of-range CellCoord: should be ignored, not crash

**Estimated test count**: ~12 integration tests

---

### S5-M4: HUD Result Overlay + Restart (UI / Integration)

**Test file path**: `tests/integration/hud/result_overlay_test.ts`

**What to test**:
- GAME_OVER event → overlay node visible=true; "Game Over" text displayed
- ROUND_CLEAR event → overlay visible=true; "Round Clear" text displayed
- Restart button click → SessionFlow.reset() called → state returns to MENU
- Overlay hidden initially (visible=false on construction)
- After reset, overlay returns to hidden state

**Edge cases**:
- GAME_OVER + ROUND_CLEAR same flush → only one overlay (first event wins or last; document choice)
- Multiple restarts (cycle) → each transitions correctly

**Estimated test count**: ~8 integration tests

---

### S5-S1: Audio Stub (Integration)

**Test file path**: `tests/integration/audio/audio_stub_test.ts`

**What to test**:
- AUDIO_EVENT with key='EXPLOSION' → AudioStub records the call (or invokes Cocos AudioEngine spy)
- AUDIO_EVENT with key='GAME_OVER' → recorded
- AUDIO_EVENT with key='ROUND_CLEAR' → recorded
- AUDIO_EVENT with key='GATE_SAFE' → recorded
- Missing audio asset → silent fallback (no crash, no thrown error)

**Edge cases**:
- 6 simultaneous AUDIO_EVENT in same flush → all played (no rate limit at stub level)
- AudioStub created without IEventBus → subscription is optional via DI

**Estimated test count**: ~6 integration tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### S5-M2: HUD Round State Display

**Verification method**: Manual walkthrough on local Cocos preview
**Who must sign off**: developer (lean mode)
**Evidence to capture**: Screenshot of HUD with round 1 → round 2 transition + alive count decrement

Checklist:
- [ ] Round number visible in upper-left or per `design/ux/hud.md`
- [ ] Alive count visible and decrements on PLAYER_KILLED
- [ ] Timer counts down from 60.0 to 0
- [ ] Labels readable on smallest target device (Toss webview min size)
- [ ] Text contrasts pass WCAG AA per `design/accessibility-requirements.md`

---

### S5-M3: HUD Grid Render + Goal Cell

**Verification method**: Screenshot diff per round
**Who must sign off**: art-director (informal — verify against art-bible color palette)
**Evidence to capture**: Screenshot of full 8×8 grid mid-round with mixed IDLE/EXPLODED cells + goal cell visible

Checklist:
- [ ] All 64 cells render in correct grid positions
- [ ] IDLE vs EXPLODED color contrast clearly visible
- [ ] Goal cell highlight is distinguishable (pulsing or border)
- [ ] No flickering on rapid state changes
- [ ] 30+ fps maintained during 56-cell pattern explosion (Toss webview)
- [ ] Frame budget: draw calls ≤ 50 (per technical-preferences.md)

---

### S5-M4: HUD Result Overlay

**Verification method**: Manual click-through
**Who must sign off**: developer + 1 playtester
**Evidence to capture**: Video clip showing GAME_OVER → overlay → Restart → MENU

Checklist:
- [ ] Overlay appears within 1 frame of GAME_OVER event
- [ ] Overlay completely hides game grid (or dims it sufficiently)
- [ ] Restart button is finger-tappable (≥ 48px per accessibility-requirements.md)
- [ ] Restart returns to MENU and starts new round on next tap

---

### S5-M6: 3 Internal Playtest Sessions

**Verification method**: Playtest sessions documented in `production/playtests/`
**Who must sign off**: developer (lean mode); if available, an external player
**Evidence to capture**: 3 playtest notes documents

Sessions required:

#### Playtest 1 — New Player Onboarding (`production/playtests/playtest-sprint-5-onboarding.md`)
- [ ] Player understood the goal within 60 seconds without dev intervention
- [ ] Player attempted at least 3 moves before dying
- [ ] Player could read all HUD elements without asking what they meant
- [ ] No "confusion loops" (player stuck not knowing what to do)

#### Playtest 2 — Mid-Game Pattern Readability (`production/playtests/playtest-sprint-5-pattern-readability.md`)
- [ ] Player could distinguish safe path from danger path at a glance
- [ ] Player did not misread an EXPLODED cell as IDLE more than 1× per 10 rounds
- [ ] Pattern variety felt sufficient (not repetitive after 5 rounds)

#### Playtest 3 — Difficulty Curve at Rounds 5/10/15 (`production/playtests/playtest-sprint-5-difficulty.md`)
- [ ] Round 5: player can survive ≥ 30s on average (cohort: 3+ runs)
- [ ] Round 10: noticeable difficulty increase (gate period faster, more gates)
- [ ] Round 15: difficulty feels "challenging but fair" (subjective; document quote from tester)
- [ ] Compare actual data to `design/difficulty-curve.md` expected values

**Verification method**: Manual on Toss 인토스 webview
**Who must sign off**: developer
**Evidence to capture**: Video of touch input → PLAYER_MOVED on real device

Checklist:

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for Sprint 5:

1. Game launches to main menu without crash (Cocos preview or Toss webview)
2. New session starts, HUD renders correctly
3. Round 1: HUD shows round number, alive count, timer counting down
4. Grid renders with mixed IDLE/EXPLODED cells; goal cell highlighted
5. Player movement → HUD reflects position update (if cursor/avatar exists)
6. PLAYER_KILLED → ALIVE_COUNT_CHANGED → HUD label updates
7. GAME_OVER → result overlay appears → Restart returns to MENU → new round starts
8. Performance: 30+ fps maintained on Toss webview target spec
9. No regressions in RoundManager / SessionFlow / GridExplosion / PlayerMovement event chains
10. Audio stub does not crash on missing assets

---

## Playtest Requirements

| Story | Playtest Goal | Min Sessions | Target Player Type |
|-------|--------------|--------------|-------------------|
| S5-M6 (Onboarding) | Can a new player understand and play within 60s? | 1 | New (no prior exposure) |
| S5-M6 (Readability) | Are EXPLODED vs IDLE cells clearly distinguishable? | 1 | Any |
| S5-M6 (Difficulty) | Does difficulty curve match design? | 1 | Any |
| S5-S2 (PatternLibrary readability) | Are patterns visually distinct enough to read? | 1 | Any |

**Sign-off requirement**: Playtest notes must be written to `production/playtests/playtest-sprint-5-[goal].md` and include:
- Session date + duration
- Player descriptor (new/experienced; any prior exposure)
- Observation notes (timestamps + what was observed)
- Pass/Fail per checklist
- Verbatim quotes (≥ 2) showing player's understanding/confusion

## Definition of Done — Sprint 5

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Integration/UI stories
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for all Visual/Feel + Config/Data stories
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced (348 baseline tests still pass)
- [ ] Code reviewed (lean mode — informal self-review acceptable)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
